item.title: From the Adafruit Learning System: PyPortal Astronauts in Space
item.description: Display the current number and names of human astronauts in space on your PyPortal display! Using CircuitPython, the PyPortal wirelessly grabs the data needed from the open-notify.org API and then turns the JSON data into a total “in-space” count! All on an attractive space background image. Touch the PyPortal’s touch screen to display the names […]
